name: Void
known: Programme: exhibitions curated by the Director and invited curators, plus free educational and outreach programmes (Photoireland wiki, Open Charities).
Vivianna Chechia has been director since May 2023 (Wikipedia).
The Void website lists Anne Kelly as Interim Director.
Trustees: Mary Scally (chair), Diane Greer, Brian Bridges, Paul Connolly, Selina Horshi, Adrian Kelly, Una McNally and Helen Quigley (Void website).
Founded by the artists' group DADA, Derry's Artists for Derry's Art, and collaborates with Ulster University on a PhD research post.

name: Dundee Contemporary Arts
known: Director Beth Bate.
Steve Grimmond was appointed Chair during 2024-25 (annual report).

name: Towner Eastbourne
known: Stephen Welton CBE became chair in November 2024, succeeding David Dimbleby, who became president.

name: Collective
known: Sorcha Carey is director (Wikipedia).

name: Edinburgh International Book Festival
known: Jenny Niven is director and chief executive.

name: Fruitmarket Gallery
known: Fiona Bradley is director.

name: Inverleith House (Royal Botanic Garden)
known: The gallery is curated by the garden itself (Wikipedia, Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh).

name: National Galleries of Scotland
known: Registered charity, about 327 staff, Director-General Anne Lyden (Wikipedia).

name: Stills
known: The director is Vivienne Gamble and three board members are named: Jane Martin, Alicia Bruce and Paul Thomson.

name: Talbot Rice Gallery
known: Tessa Giblin has been director since November 2016, succeeding Pat Fisher (Wikipedia).

The TRG Supporters' Programme has tiers from £250 a year (Supporter) to £5,000 (Director's Circle), and the TRG Commissioning Fund was set up for the gallery's 50th anniversary (Talbot Rice support page).

name: BALTIC Centre for Contemporary Art
known: Its first director, Sune Nordgren, was appointed in 1997 and left after almost six years.
Sarah Munro became director in November 2015 (Wikipedia).

name: The Common Guild
known: Katrina Brown was Founder Director and stepped down after 19 years, and Chloë Reith has been appointed Director (stated by the space).

name: Turn End
known: The Aldington family and founder trustees formed the Turn End Trust in 1998, and it became a charitable incorporated organisation in 2015 (the Trust's site, Find that Charity).

name: Hay Festival
known: Julie Finch was its chief executive in 2024.
